description:
Use this when you need a division-specific Malaysian public-holiday result. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when the division is unknown, or you need an employer, bank, exchange, school or inferred replacement-day calendar.
What it computes: Checks a Malaysian date with a required federal-territory/state division, BKPP/JPM's 2027 public-holiday table and division weekly-rest baseline.
Example user requests: Is 2027-02-08 a working day in Kuala Lumpur? | Check 2027-06-06 in Terengganu.
Inputs: date (date); division (enum).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2027-02-08","division":"KUL"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, division, division_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, weekend_days, holiday_names, holiday_observed, rest_day_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_scope, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: is_working_day = division weekly baseline and no applicable BKPP event
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/malaysia-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/malaysia-working-day.md

date.description: Gregorian date in the pinned 2027 coverage.

division.description: Required federal-territory/state code: KUL, LBN, PJY, JHR, KDH, KTN, MLK, NSN, PHG, PRK, PLS, PNG, SBH, SWK, SGR or TRG.

name: check_my_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Selected division's federal/state public holidays and weekly baseline.

day_type.description: Regular weekday, official weekend or public holiday.

holiday_names.description: Official events applying to the date.

holiday_observed.description: Always false here because no substitute date is inferred.

is_working_day.description: False for the division's declared weekly baseline or applicable official holiday.

rest_day_policy.description: Employer roster and replacement-day policy are not inferred.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Malaysia Division Public-Holiday Working Day
